subject: Champion wiring, MAP tasks and EB availability — DataWave close plan
messages:
From: Laura Burns <laura.burns@datawave.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@datawave.io
Date: 2027-04-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec liaison wiring & EB availability for Q3 close

Hi Stephanie / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the stakeholders were impressed. We need to lock the executive briefing (EB) window and a short MAP that shows who owns what to make our procurement/board week timeline. Our Board has two preferred windows: 2027-05-10–12 and 2027-05-17–18 (afternoons PT).

Can you:
- Share a one-page MAP with owners and deadlines for the evaluation run (security questionnaire, pilot metrics, legal review)?
- Confirm which Redwood exec can join the EB and availability for the two-week windows above
- Provide a draft invitation list for the EB (names / roles) so we can align on invitees

I've attached our EB availability sheet — it has internal attendee names and their constraints.

Attachments: DataWave_EB_availability.xlsx

Laura Burns
VP of Technology Strategy | DataWave, Inc.
laura.burns@datawave.io | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Burns <laura.burns@datawave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec liaison wiring & EB availability for Q3 close

Hi Laura — thanks for the note and the availability sheet. High level yes, we can hit those windows. I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a proposed EB invite list for your review.

Quick summary of what we'll own and ask from DataWave:
- Redwood: provide sandbox access for 2-week eval, run security questionnaire response (SOC2/infra), provide an exec for a 30–45m EB, prepare performance scorecard from pilot.
- DataWave: confirm evaluation success metrics (latency & throughput targets), provide contact for legal/procurement for SOW redlines, approve EB invitees and final time window.

Proposed EB times (PT):
- Option A: Tue 2027-05-11 1:30–2:15pm PT
- Option B: Wed 2027-05-18 2:00–2:45pm PT

Owner assignments (draft):
- MAP owner (final doc): Stephanie Nguyen (I will shepherd tasks & deadlines)
- Sponsor invites & exec logistics: Marissa Cole (she will lead outreach)
- Pilot engineering owner: Ben Carter (technical point, will own scorecard)
- Legal & procurement coordination: Rishi Malhotra (will own SOW turn)

Please review the attached drafts: Draft_MAP_v3.pdf and the EB invite list. If those windows look good, Marissa will send provisional invites and Ben will spin up the pilot workspace next week.

Attachments: Draft_MAP_v3.pdf, EB_invite_list_v1.xlsx

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-22T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec liaison wiring & EB availability for Q3 close

All — I can take the invite sends and the EB logistics. I'll do two things this morning:
1) Load DataWave attendee names into the EB sheet and mark required vs optional.
2) Draft the calendar invite text (exec brief + Q&A + next steps) and share with Laura for approval.

On MAP timing: I propose a compact runway so we don't lose momentum. Suggested timeline:
- Week 0 (2027-04-26): Kickoff and sandbox access granted
- Week 1 (2027-05-03): Pilot run + scorecard data collection
- Week 2 (2027-05-10 to 05-17): EB and legal review / SOW turnaround

I'll also add a column in the MAP for escalation owner (if an issue arises during evaluation). Ben, can you confirm you can have the performance scorecard template ready by Friday 2027-04-23?

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Burns <laura.burns@datawave.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@datawave.io
Date: 2027-04-22T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec liaison wiring & EB availability for Q3 close

Thanks Marissa — the proposed runway works for us. I've updated our availability sheet with two confirmed VIPs who must attend the EB (CTO and Head of Ops).

Contracts note: our procurement team will need a redlineable SOW. I've attached SOW_v2-DataWave.pdf — please have Rishi review and highlight any standard Redwood terms that typically take longer (data residency, support SLA).

Also, can you route the DocuSign link for the initial Order Form once the SOW is agreed? I can prioritize exec schedules on our side once the calendar invite is live.

Attachments: SOW_v2-DataWave.pdf
DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/link/abcd-efgh-1234

Laura
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Burns <laura.burns@datawave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec liaison wiring & EB availability for Q3 close

Laura — perfect, thanks. Final next steps I will own and run to completion: 
- Today (2027-04-23): Rishi will review SOW_v2 and send a summary of any non-standard items by EOD PST.
- Fri 2027-04-23: Ben confirms scorecard template availability (cc'd).
- Mon 2027-04-26: We will provision sandbox access and share credentials with your pilot team.
- Tue 2027-05-10 or Wed 2027-05-18: EB (we'll finalize after you confirm which option you prefer)
- Wed 2027-05-19: Target date for signed Order Form (DocuSign) if SOW redlines are routine.

Action items assigned:
- Marissa: send provisional EB invites to exec list and include note that final time TBD; attach MAP one-pager.
- Ben: prepare scorecard template and pilot run checklist.
- Rishi: SOW redline summary + suggested exceptions list.

I'll update the HubSpot deal with the MAP and milestone dates once Rishi's SOW notes are in. HubSpot (deal link): https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456/DEAL-9087

Attachments included in mailbox: Draft_MAP_v3.pdf, DataWave_EB_availability.xlsx, SOW_v2-DataWave.pdf

Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
